title: Copper oxide nanoparticles mitigate cadmium–arsenic phytotoxicity to rice plants (O. sativa) and protect Daphnia magna via soil–water partitioning
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01106J, Paper
Xingyu Yan, Jing Liu, Wenhui Li, Jiayi Su, Jiawei Wang, Zhongxiang Cao
nCuO reduced the mobility and phytotoxicity of Cd and As rice seedlings, and exhibited lower aquatic risk to Daphnia magna (compared to CuCl2·2H2O).
